corrections.correction: The +5/+8/+9 diary observations belong to vanilla Sourcenext. They must not be labeled as a PC-PK probability sample.
Save/reload selection for larger gains prevents frequency inference. Five equally spaced synthetic outcomes are an explicit software choice, not an estimate from those examples.
The synthetic cash rule ignores ruler charisma and target giri. That is a known fidelity divergence; no replacement coefficient is invented.
Persist and mutate the true 0..255 byte. Display only min(trueLoyalty,100). A successful reward can change 99 to 108; an existing displayed 100 is ineligible.

The new adapter consumes returnedAl > 25 without modulo-150 normalization. It does not compare signed32 or full EAX for this branch. The third candidate branch is a local graph mapping to synthetic full EAX 0 or 1.
Original signed ambition >=4 is represented by ===4 only within the explicitly supported 0..4 trait domain; no full-domain equivalence is claimed.
New software integration does not change existing affinity, natural-candidate or nonnatural-loyalty evidence records, and does not close or reduce the original 43 evidence groups.

cash.qualification: Every target exists in the fixed ordinary roster, has displayed loyalty below 100 and has not been praised in the current turn. Any failure rejects the whole selection before random draws.
cash.gain: 5 + nextBounded(5), exactly one draw per target
cash.provenance: Explicit new synthetic policy, not a recovered PK formula.

natural.calendar: Advance 1 -> 11 -> 21 -> next month 1; run natural loyalty only when entering January, April, July or October 1.
candidateOrder: Officer likes ruler, spouse, sworn sibling, or either parent-child direction exemption
Officer-directed dislikes-ruler graph edge mapped to nonzero synthetic EAX
natural.selectionLimit: Relation interpretation, ordered roster and tutorial-to-caller adapter are standalone software policies, not recovered native helpers.
natural.control: For a candidate with human-heart-control, nextBounded(3) >= 1 protects; no loss calls follow protection.
natural.zeroAndAbove100: Candidates at true loyalty 0 still consume their full selected draw path. Values above 100 are reduced as true bytes and may still display 100.
natural.nonCandidate: Exemptions and failed candidate gates consume no natural RNG. Token-platform presence cannot create a candidate.
natural.tokenPlatformBasis: Selected-listing software policy: 0058E759 +2 bears the author annotation 【修改】符节台附加忠诚下降值. It is not certified stock behavior; the two appended MOD variants remain separate.

rng.stream: Cash and natural commands share one persistent session-local stream. Other services, existing recruitment rolls and original global random streams do not consume it.
rng.distributionQualification: The complete nonzero xorshift32 cycle has 2^32-1 states, divisible by 3 and 5, so full-cycle bucket counts balance. This does not certify finite-sequence independence, seed quality, or any original-game distribution.
rng.sourceProbabilityQualification: A two-thirds control skip and triangular two-roll illustration assume independent uniform draws; they are not authenticated original random-stream probabilities.

transactions.atomicity: Validate all targets, resources, revision and complete output budgets before accepting the detached result. A failure changes no state and reserves no ID.
transactions.idempotence: Same ID and canonical envelope returns the original receipt with current state. Same ID and different canonical envelope rejects.
transactions.preview: Uses the same detached derivation, command output budget and save-result budget gates, plus a budget for its own result; consumes no persistent random state and does not reserve the ID.
transactions.canonicalization: Officer IDs and cash targets sort by code unit; relation edges are sorted, and symmetric pairs are normalized before comparison.

persistence.contents: Full canonical initial scenario, genesis snapshot, complete policy values and digest, accepted envelopes and receipts, and final snapshot.
persistence.authority: Runtime replays from the initial scenario and seed, recomputes every accepted command, compares complete receipts and final snapshot, and enforces every intermediate command and save-result output budget. Supplied snapshots and digests are never state authority.
persistence.schemaRole: The JSON Schema describes closed JSON structures and constants. It is not a proof of reachable state, source fidelity, deterministic execution, or runtime conformance.
persistence.traceRole: Expected outcomes and expectedFinalSnapshot are optional assertions represented by null when omitted; they never provide selected personnel, rolls, gain/loss or state mutations.
persistence.budgetQualification: The 8 MiB limit includes canonical serialization of complete result wrappers. In particular, SaveResult {ok:true,json:canonical(state)} is budgeted after the saved JSON string is escaped inside the wrapper. Creation and each successful detached command check this save-result budget before acceptance; preview checks its own result too. Individual maxima share the byte, node and depth limits and are not promised to be simultaneously attainable.

runtimeOnlyInvariants: Reject accessors, symbols, hidden data, custom prototypes, sparse arrays, cycles, undefined, nonfinite numbers, fractions and negative zero before domain processing.

Check ID membership and uniqueness, fixed force/city/ruler links, no self-relations, undirected pair normalization, one spouse per person, at most two parents per child and an acyclic parent-child graph.
